verdict.rationale: Filee documents audio transcoding to many formats (MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus, AAC, WavPack, TTA) and video conversion with H.264/HEVC hardware encoding and a 720p option. That shows some codec choice and a single resolution option, but no bitrate control. Missing for 10: documented bitrate control, granular resolution selection beyond a 720p option, explicit user-selectable codec settings for audio and video, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, audio and video transcode between formats with control over codec, bitrate, and resolution

citations.quote: hardware video encoding (H.264 and HEVC on NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF, VideoToolbox or VA-API)
with a 720p option, hardware encoding on the graphics chip, audio extraction to MP3 or M4A
Music, recordings and voice memos to MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus, AAC or lossless WavPack and TTA.
